import AxeBuilder from "@axe-core/playwright";
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { browserPassword } from "../support/browser-identities.ts";

async function login(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.goto("/");
  await page.getByLabel("Email", { exact: true }).fill(`${name}@example.test`);
  await page.getByLabel("Password", { exact: true }).fill(browserPassword);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Open equipment", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Equipment", exact: true })).toBeFocused();
}
async function csrf(page: Page): Promise<string> { return (await (await page.request.get("/api/auth/me")).json()).csrfToken; }
async function accessible(page: Page) {
  expect((await new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21aa", "wcag22aa"]).analyze()).violations).toEqual([]);
}

test("a member reserves, independently reads, reloads and returns a persisted loan [QLT-01, QLT-12, QLT-14]", async ({ page }) => {
  await login(page, "loan-ada");
  const reserve = page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true });
  await reserve.focus(); await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  const mine = await (await page.request.get("/api/loans")).json();
  expect(mine.items).toHaveLength(1); expect(mine.items[0].returnedAt).toBeNull();
  expect((await (await page.request.get("/api/items")).json()).items.find((item: { id: string }) => item.id === "journey").available).toBe(false);
  await page.reload();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Journey microscope", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.reload();
  expect((await (await page.request.get("/api/loans")).json()).items[0].returnedAt).not.toBeNull();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Journey microscope", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
  await accessible(page);
  await page.screenshot({ path: test.info().outputPath("equipment-desktop.png"), fullPage: true });
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 812 });
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
  await accessible(page);
  await page.screenshot({ path: test.info().outputPath("equipment-mobile.png"), fullPage: true });
});

test("stale availability conflicts; the server denies another member's return and admin overview [QLT-01, QLT-12, QLT-14]", async ({ page, browser }) => {
  const other = await browser.newContext(); const ben = await other.newPage();
  try {
    await login(page, "loan-ada"); await login(ben, "loan-ben");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Shared microscope", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Shared microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    const loan = (await (await page.request.get("/api/loans")).json()).items.find((loan: { itemId: string }) => loan.itemId === "race");
    await ben.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Shared microscope", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(ben.getByRole("alert")).toContainText("already on loan");
    await expect(ben.getByRole("alert")).toBeFocused();
    expect((await ben.request.post(`/api/loans/${loan.id}/return`, { headers: { "x-csrf-token": await csrf(ben) } })).status()).toBe(403);
    expect((await ben.request.get("/api/admin/loans")).status()).toBe(403);
    expect(JSON.stringify(await (await ben.request.get("/api/items")).json())).not.toContain("loan-ada");
    expect((await (await ben.request.get("/api/loans")).json()).items).toEqual([]);
    await expect(ben.getByText("loan-ada@example.test", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    await accessible(ben);
    await ben.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh equipment", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(ben.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Shared microscope", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Shared microscope", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Shared microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  } finally { await other.close(); }
});

test("the real admin overview identifies the borrower [QLT-01, QLT-12]", async ({ page }) => {
  await login(page, "loan-admin");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  try {
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Loan overview", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Loan overview", exact: true }).getByText("loan-admin@example.test").first()).toBeVisible();
    const overview = await page.request.get("/api/admin/loans");
    expect(overview.status()).toBe(200);
    expect((await overview.json()).items.some((loan: { borrower: { email: string } }) => loan.borrower.email === "loan-admin@example.test")).toBe(true);
    await accessible(page);
  } finally {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Return Journey microscope", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  }
});

test("equipment loading, network failure, retry and empty states stay accessible [QLT-14]", async ({ page }) => {
  let release!: () => void;
  const held = new Promise<void>(resolve => { release = resolve; });
  await page.route("**/api/items?*", async route => { await held; await route.abort(); });
  await login(page, "loan-states");
  await expect(page.getByText("Loading equipment…", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  release();
  await expect(page.getByRole("alert")).toBeFocused();
  await accessible(page);
  await page.unroute("**/api/items?*");
  await page.route("**/api/items?*", route => route.fulfill({ json: { items: [], limit: 25, offset: 0, total: 0 } }));
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh equipment", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("No equipment is listed yet.", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await accessible(page);
  await page.unroute("**/api/items?*");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh equipment", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  // A synthetic refusal exercises the UI state; real owner/role denials are asserted above.
  let resume!: () => void, entered!: () => void, attempts = 0;
  const pending = new Promise<void>(resolve => { resume = resolve; });
  const started = new Promise<void>(resolve => { entered = resolve; });
  await page.route("**/api/items/journey/reserve", async route => {
    attempts++; entered(); await pending;
    await route.fulfill({ status: 403, json: { type: "urn:problem:forbidden", title: "Forbidden", status: 403, detail: "This action is denied.", correlationId: "loan-browser-fixture" } });
  });
  try {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true }).click(); await started;
    await expect(page.getByText("Confirming the change…", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[aria-busy="true"]').getByText("Confirming the change…", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reserve Journey microscope", exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh equipment", exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(attempts).toBe(1);
    await accessible(page);
  } finally { resume(); }
  await expect(page.getByRole("alert")).toContainText("This action is denied.");
  await expect(page.getByRole("alert")).toBeFocused();
  await accessible(page);

});
